SignalStrength.description: Integers in a row that end at 0 are spelled with 0 among them.

Second.description: Integers in a row from 0 are spelled with 0 among them, and no sign.

Tempo.description: Integers in a row whose first digits are the same are spelled from that digit.

Level.description: A row of integers after other values is spelled too.

NegativeZero.description: -0 is not an integer TypeScript reads back from its text, so it stays out of a row.

Huge.description: Integers past those a number holds exactly are listed.

Floor.description: Integers in a row below 0 are spelled without 0.

Rate.description: Integers in a row whose first digits are next to each other are spelled from the lower bound and up to the upper one, with no first digit between them.

CloseCode.description: Integers in a row whose spelling is no shorter than the list are listed.

Score.description: Numbers written with a fraction keep their notation, so they are listed, not spelled as integers.

DaysOfMonth.description: Spelled integers as array items need no parentheses.
